mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.object_key FROM image i WHERE i.mime_type LIKE 'image/%' AND i.create_time < TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -#{retentionHours}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM time_card tc WHERE tc.image_id = i.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recipe r WHERE r.image_id = i.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM love_record_image lri WHERE lri.image_id = i.id ) ORDER BY i.create_time, i.id LIMIT #{batchSize}

#{objectKey}
